name: Makubetsu (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Makubetsu town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing the character 幕 above a downward point.
history: Municipal flag of Makubetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 24 December 1961.

features.role: Makubetsu town emblem — a broken ring enclosing the character 幕 above a downward point
